items.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri 1.1 weights under Apache 2.0, seven weeks after Kolibri 1
items.summary: Aleph Alpha shipped a second iteration of its Kolibri model with open weights under Apache 2.0, which can be downloaded from Hugging Face. The post claims better quality, speed and efficiency; no numbers in the post itself.

items.title: OpenCode 2.4.0 adds an automation tool that agents can use to schedule runs or react to MCP events
items.summary: OpenCode's new release lets the agent create automations that run on a schedule or on MCP events and trigger prompts, shell commands or a code-mode script with access to its MCP tools.

items.title: Xing4.1-Preview: 285B MoE (17B active) for agentic coding with native 1M context, on ModelScope
items.summary: A preview of a 285B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 17B per token and supports a 1M-token window, aimed at agentic coding; the post cites Terminal-Bench results and links the ModelScope collection.

items.title: Omarchy adds a Local Models panel that warns whether a local model fits in RAM before it starts
items.summary: The Linux distro's new panel estimates memory use for local AI models (the post cites about 100 GiB for one model at its full 256K context) before launch, so a user does not start a model that will not fit. PRs are linked.

items.title: TensorFold fork adds NVFP4 mode: MiniMax H3-Image warm render drops from 13.2s to 10.7s on a DGX Spark
items.summary: On a DGX Spark an NVFP4 option in a TensorFold fork cuts a warm image generation from 13.2s to 10.7s with the same prompt and seed, at the cost of flatter colors, so it ships as an opt-in.

items.title: TensorFold fork --far-pool option: 4096x4096 MiniMax H3-Image goes from 55s to 49s on an M5 Ultra Mac Studio
items.summary: A new opt-in flag in a TensorFold fork speeds a 4096x4096 image render on an M5 Ultra Mac Studio from 55s to 49s with, as far as the author can tell, the same output.

items.title: VS Code adds experimental app-window screenshot capture with crop and markup as Copilot chat context
items.summary: Experimental setting lets a user capture a browser or app window, crop and annotate it, and attach it to a Copilot chat so the agent sees exactly what to change.

items.title: olmOCR-bench looks saturated: top score moved from 87.6 to 87.8 in seven months while ParseBench rose from 74.3 to 79.0
items.summary: A Hugging Face leaderboard view of ten models since April shows almost no headroom left on the olmOCR OCR benchmark, while ParseBench still discriminates; useful for choosing which document-parsing eval to trust.

items.title: Apple's FastFrames video models: VAE decoding and KV-cache updates were over half of autoregressive video diffusion latency
items.summary: A summary of Apple's FastFrames work (Wan 2.1 fine-tunes at 1.3B and 14B) reporting that the unglamorous VAE decode and KV-cache steps, not the denoiser, dominated end-to-end latency.

items.title: OpenBMB LexReward: rubric reward models for legal answers on style, element and chain, 81.75% pairwise accuracy for LexRM-Style
items.summary: A rubric-based reward modeling approach for legal reasoning that scores style, element coverage and reasoning chain; the post reports 81.75% pairwise selection accuracy for the style model.

items.title: MemTrace memory observability integrated into EverOS, a local-first memory runtime for agents
items.summary: MemTrace, an observability layer for agent memory, is now integrated into EverOS, which provides a local-first memory runtime for AI agents.
